item.title: ANCO CODE RED TEST
item.description: As severe weather season approaches, Anderson County Emergency Management officials believe they finally have the Code Red System back up and running. They are going to test the system on Monday, March 2nd, at noon. If you get a message, don’t worry, you don’t have to do anything. item.description: Diving into an ice cold lake in the middle of winter is not what most of us would consider a good time, even if the temperatures are unseasonably warm; BUT… there will be a lot of people doing just that Saturday at the Shawnee Mission Park Lake beach. item.title: KODOIN EXPANSION BEGINS
item.description: A promised expansion of a Paola company has begun. Kodion Energy employees joined local and national elected officials in a groundbreaking ceremony Friday, February 20th, at Paola’s industrial park. Kodion is building a new 120,000 square foot facility to serve it’s growing business making transformers. item.description: Franklin County is blessed to have two major state park trails intersecting in Ottawa. Ever wonder where they go or where other trails in the state might be. item.title: COLYER IN GARNETT THURSDAY
